// <auto-generated/>
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.Loader;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using CobolCS.Generated;

if (args[0] == "--worker")
{
    var count = 0;
    var reusable = CanReuse(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly());
    while (Console.ReadLine() is { } line)
    {
        var request = JsonNode.Parse(line)!;
        var id = request["programId"]!.GetValue<string>();
        var candidate = request["candidate"]!.ToJsonString();
        var response = JsonNode.Parse(reusable ? ProbeEntry.Run(id, candidate) : Isolated(id, candidate))!;
        response["workerIsolation"] = reusable ? "verified-static-state" : "fresh-assembly";
        Console.WriteLine(response.ToJsonString());
        Console.Out.Flush();
        if (!reusable && ++count % 8 == 0)
        {
            GC.Collect();
            GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
            GC.Collect();
        }
    }

    return;
}

Console.WriteLine(ProbeEntry.Run(args[0], File.ReadAllText(args[1])));

static bool CanReuse(Assembly assembly)
{
    foreach (var type in assembly.GetTypes())
    {
        foreach (var field in type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly))
        {
            if (field.IsLiteral) continue;
            if (field.IsInitOnly && field.Name == "<Empty>k__BackingField"
                && type.FullName == "CobolCS.Generated.BranchSnapshot") continue;
            if (field.IsInitOnly && field.FieldType.IsValueType && type.FullName == "<PrivateImplementationDetails>") continue;
            if (field.IsInitOnly && field.FieldType == typeof(System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions)
                && field.GetValue(null) is System.Text.Json.JsonSerializerOptions { IsReadOnly: true }) continue;
            // C#コンパイラーが作る、状態を持たないラムダのdelegate cacheだけを許可します。
            if (type.IsDefined(typeof(CompilerGeneratedAttribute), false)
                && type.GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic).Length == 0
                && (field.FieldType == type || typeof(Delegate).IsAssignableFrom(field.FieldType))) continue;
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
static string Isolated(string id, string candidate)
{
    var context = new AssemblyLoadContext("branch-trial", isCollectible: true);
    try
    {
        var assembly = context.LoadFromAssemblyPath(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().Location);
        return (string)assembly.GetType("ProbeEntry")!.GetMethod("Run")!.Invoke(null, [id, candidate])!;
    }
    finally
    {
        context.Unload();
    }
}
